name: fundraise-up-for-organizations
description: Turn your fundraising data into actionable insights, right in your AI chat

interface.longDescription:
Bring your fundraising into the conversation. Fundraise Up connects your AI assistant to your organization's fundraising data, so you can explore results, understand your donors, and spot opportunities without exporting spreadsheets or switching between dashboards.

Get a quick fundraising pulse check or dig into the details. Compare giving across periods, discover your top supporters, track recurring giving and retention, and see which campaigns, countries, and traffic sources drive donations. Explore fundraising results, measure the contribution of Fundraise Up's AI features, and follow donations made or referred by AI assistants. From a leadership briefing to a closer look at a single donation, start with a question and build from there.
capabilities: Read Insights reports and AI feature performance
defaultPrompt: Give me a fundraising summary for last month
How are our recurring plans doing this quarter?
Who are our top supporters, and how many new donors did we gain this year?

positive.description: Sign in as the demo user of MCP Test Organization (AELCTDYS); its data starts on 2026-08-12. Compare monthly fundraising totals and donation types.
positive.prompt: How much did we raise in September 2026 compared to August 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports September 2026 totals of $214.76 from 9 donations versus August 2026 totals of $1,713.10 from 14 donations, with the one-time and first-installment amount and count split returned by the tool; does not assume those two parts include recurring renewals.

positive.description: Sign in as the demo user of MCP Test Organization (AELCTDYS); its data starts on 2026-08-12. List recent donations with statuses and original currencies.
positive.prompt: Show my last 10 donations with their status
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the 10 most recent donations, all succeeded, comprising 4 monthly and 6 one-time donations; preserves each donation currency (USD, PLN or EUR) and does not sum mixed currencies.

positive.description: Sign in as the demo user of MCP Test Organization (AELCTDYS); its data starts on 2026-08-12. Summarize recurring plans for Q3 without a pre-account comparison.
positive.prompt: How are our recurring plans doing in the third quarter of 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports 3 active plans, 3 new plans, 0 cancelled, 0 reactivated and $108 expected monthly volume for Q3 2026; does not compare with Q2 because the account did not exist yet.

positive.description: Sign in as the demo user of MCP Test Organization (AELCTDYS); its data starts on 2026-08-12. Resolve a campaign name before retrieving its fundraising totals.
positive.prompt: How much did the Clean Water campaign raise in 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds one campaign, "Clean Water Wells and Boreholes — Verdant Basin", uses its returned key to filter the 2026 statistics, and reports $215.60 from 4 donations.

positive.description: Sign in as the demo user of MCP Test Organization (AELCTDYS); its data starts on 2026-08-12. Combine lifetime supporter rankings with period-specific donor growth.
positive.prompt: Who are our top 5 supporters, and how many new donors did we get in September 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the top 5 supporters by lifetime giving, using returned names and amounts of $535, $268, $268, $161 and $129, and reports 6 new donors in September 2026; clearly distinguishes lifetime giving from the monthly donor count.

negative.description: Refunds and recurring plan cancellations are not supported: every tool is read-only. The assistant may look up the latest donation and its recurring plan, then explains it cannot refund or cancel and points to the Fundraise Up Dashboard; nothing is changed.
negative.prompt: Refund the last donation and cancel that donor's recurring plan

negative.description: General fundraising copywriting needs no account data, so the plugin should not be invoked. The assistant writes a generic template without calling Fundraise Up tools.
negative.prompt: Write a thank-you email template for nonprofit donors without using any account data.

negative.description: Calendar events are outside the plugin's scope, so it should not be invoked. The assistant does not call Fundraise Up tools and says it has no access to the calendar through this plugin.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: The plugin only reads fundraising data. It does not sell products, process donations or payments, or issue refunds.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 24 read-only tools over donations, supporters, recurring plans, campaigns, designations, subaccounts, account info and Insights reports.
